sloka: प्राणश्यत तदा सर्वं हव्यं हुतमिवानले ।युद्ध्वा च सुचिरं कालं कृत्वा विक्रममुत्तमम् ।। ७.१९.१५ ॥
transliteration: prāṇaśyata tadā sarvaṁ havyaṁ hutamivānale ।yuddhvā ca suciraṁ kālaṁ kṛtvā vikramamuttamam ।। 7.19.15 ॥

translations.english: That amazing battle between King Anaraṇya and the lord of Rākṣasas commenced when the king's army encountered Ravana's army.
